title: Resin from the Salamat
body: Khoja Ismail comes ashore from the Salamat with a bowl of frankincense to show the buyers. His torn foresail is spread out for mending. The palace steward wants the resin, but a perfumer in the Gujarati quarter has buyers of her own. Ismail says either can take it if the money is ready today.

choices.label: Buy the whole lot for the palace stores
choices.outcome_text: The court pays the market price, and Ismail leaves with enough coin to pay his sailmaker. The palace steward is pleased; the perfumer has to send her customers elsewhere.

choices.label: Leave the lot to the perfumer
choices.outcome_text: The perfumer buys it in the open market. Ismail pays his sailmaker either way, but the palace steward must make do with what he has.
